scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The proof is self-contained from the published facet-network definitions. Literature comparisons distinguish the discrete polytope operator from smooth centro-affine inequalities and retain a bibliographic residual risk concerning future or unlocated details.
limitations: The result is restricted to the Hu--Ivaki facet-network normalization on full-dimensional origin-symmetric parallelotopes.
It does not claim that the eigenvalue \(n\) characterizes parallelotopes, nor that every parallelotope is a local or global minimizer.
The exact-rational script is a finite sanity check; the theorem for all dimensions rests on the analytic affine-covariance and box calculation.

title: Exact even centro-affine facet spectrum of parallelotopes
